notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Zacama.
Zacama dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Zacama to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Zacama enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's abilities.
